card.name: Negation words inside descriptive clauses
card.fires_on: Small negating or reducing words such as not, without, lower, little, less than and n't, placed mid-clause before the thing being excluded or reduced.

modes.label: Plain negation
modes.description: The words not or n't appear after a subject or helper verb, before a verb or noun phrase.
modes.example: A teacher who would<< not>> send home the very object of your frustration

modes.label: Reduction or absence
modes.description: Words like lower, little, without or less than introduce a smaller amount or a missing item.
modes.example: Greater roadrunners prefer open country with<< little>> brush to slow them down.

card.plain: It marks little words that say something is absent, not present, or smaller, in the middle of a sentence.
